newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Grenade kills Colombia policeman in officers' mess.
newsitem.headline: Grenade kills Colombia policeman in officers' mess.

text.p: A police lieutenant dropped a grenade in an officers' mess in northern Colombia on Monday, killing himself and injuring his commander, authorities said.

Gen. Tobias Quintanilla, police commander for northern Santander province, said the apparent accident occurred in the dining room of the police headquarters in Barrancabermeja, Colombia's main oil production centre.
He said the lieutenant, Carlos Torres, was showing off a rifle-propelled grenade, a weapon often used by the country's leftist guerrillas, when it slipped out of his hands for "unknown" reasons.
Torres was dead on arrival at a local hospital and his commander, Col. Jorge Eduardo Martinez, suffered shrapnel wounds in his legs.
